description: This file defines the DefaultHttpProxyConfig class, which provides an implementation for HTTP proxy configuration, including methods to parse configuration, access properties, and create client transport objects.

classes.name: DefaultHttpProxyConfig
classes.description: Immutable class representing the HTTP proxy configuration, including methods for creating instances from configuration and generating client transport objects.

methods.name: ofHttpProxy
methods.description: Creates an instance based on HTTP proxy configuration at the specified config path.

methods.name: ofProxy
methods.description: Creates an instance based on proxy configuration at the 'proxy' config path.

methods.name: toClientTransport
methods.description: Converts proxy configuration into an Akka ClientTransport object, with optional credentials.
